act_link_info.title: AGS: IGNITE 2026
act_link_info.appendixDesc: Lets grow your agency & get rewards!

textContent.value:
1. BIGO reserves the right to deduct points earned if any form of violation is identified by the organizer (e.g. low-quality content, passive livestreaming, account sharing/proxy streaming, etc.).
2. Agencies MUST REGISTER once to be eligible to participate in this event. Although the rankings and points are displayed for reference, an unregistered agency will NOT receive the corresponding rewards.
3. Compared to the previous month, the agency’s total points must at least remain the same or increase in order to continue to participate in this event and receive that month's rewards.
4. If the agency level decreases by more than one level compared to the previous month, they will be disqualified from the event series.
5. All rewards to be redeemed (products or exposure opportunities) must be claimed by contacting the official BIGO administrator within one month after the event ends. If the reward is not claimed within one month, it will be forfeited.
6. Any illegal or improper means will result in disqualification from the event.
7. BIGO reserves the final decision rights on all online/offline exposure, promotional materials, and/or physical rewards.
8. (MY agencies only) If overseas beans exceed 70% of the agency’s total beans, all points earned from overseas beans will be deducted. If overseas beans are below 70%, points will not be deducted.
